structure.movingDesc: When you drag a channel into another category, choose whether its permission overwrites should match that category (inherit its permission rows) or stay independent.
structure.keepDesc: Leave the channel’s permission rows as they are (recommended if you customized this channel).
structure.syncDesc: Clear the channel’s permission overwrites so it inherits from the destination category (same as “Sync with category” in channel settings).
structure.askDesc: Prompt on each channel move so you can pick keep or sync per action.
structure.categoryOrderDesc: Drag entire categories to change how they appear in the channel list.
structure.otherChannelsDesc: Channels not grouped under a category header share one order (same as the sidebar).

youtube.preview: Preview mode doesn’t use a live account, so YouTube can’t be linked here.
youtube.linkedNeedsEgress: Linked, but stage go-live needs LiveKit egress on this server
youtube.savedNeedsEgress: Saved, but stage go-live needs LiveKit egress on this server
youtube.channelLinkPriority: Channel link takes priority for go-live. Revoke the channel link to use this stream key on stages.
youtube.confirm: I understand Echo will encrypt this key and I won’t be able to view it again in Settings. I can revoke and enter a new key later.
youtube.notEnabled: YouTube live isn’t enabled on this Echo server yet. An admin needs to set {oauth} and {redirect} for channel linking, or you can still use a stream key once the server can store encrypted credentials ({encKey}).
youtube.savedAt: Saved {date}. Echo cannot display the key again.
